title: Order form and record for a registrant return or recall
rule_summary: Each registrant shall maintain a record of each return or recall transaction in accordance with the information required of manufacturers in 21 CFR 1304.22(a)(2)(iv). Each registrant that delivers a controlled substance in Schedule I or II for the purpose of return or recall shall use an order form in the manner described in 21 CFR part 1305. Deliveries for the purpose of return or recall may be made through a freight forwarding facility operated by the person to whom the controlled substance is being returned, provided that advance notice of the return is given and delivery is directly to an agent or employee of that person.
exam_relevance: Tests whether the candidate remembers that a Schedule II return or recall runs on an order form and leaves a transaction record, rather than on the destruction paperwork.
common_confusions: A DEA Form 41 is a record of destruction and is not the instrument for a return or recall.
verification_notes: Read in the current eCFR text of 21 CFR 1317.10 on ecfr.gov on 2026-09-11. Added as a new rule so that no released adjudication is disturbed. A fresh independent audit is still required before any section relying on it is published.
